aboutH2: Valiant Behavioural Health: A Holistic Approach in Mental Health and Substance Abuse Treatment
intro: Valiant Behavioural Health is a leading facility in Ottawa, Ontario, that fills a void in the mental health and substance abuse field. Our mission is to help clients recover from dual diagnosis issues through our individualized inpatient treatment program. We understand that addiction is a complex problem that requires a holistic approach to solve the issue. To address the issue, we use a BIO-Psycho-Social-Spiritual perspective in our treatment program.

Our team of qualified health professionals provides a safe and supportive environment to help clients realize their full potential. We prioritize personalized attention, which is why we only take in a maximum of 9 clients at a time. This approach allows us to meet the individual needs of each client. Furthermore, we include 8 individual private counselling sessions each month, these sessions allow us to focus on the specific issues important to each person’s recovery.

pillars.title: 90-Day Program: Taking a Comprehensive Approach to Recovery
pillars.body: Valiant Behavioural Health is proud to offer a comprehensive 90-day program that addresses a wide range of topics that clients face in their recovery journey. Our inpatient program includes topics like anxiety and depression, grief and loss, codependency, trauma, anger, relapse prevention, 12-Step, EMDR, CBT, DBT, and many other topics and modalities. Our program ensures that each client receives the personalized attention and support needed to overcome these challenges.

pillars.title: Green Environment: A haven away from the hustle and bustle of the city
pillars.body: Valiant Behavioural Health’s serene location in the area of Carlsbad Springs, just south of downtown Ottawa, provides our clients with a peaceful retreat. Surrounded by evergreen trees, our five-acre property provides a peaceful and calming environment that is conducive to healing. The creek that runs through the property provides our clients with a peaceful place to reflect on their new lease on life.

pillars.title: Support That Continues After Carlsbad Springs
pillars.body: Before you go home, you meet with the follow-up counsellor to put together an aftercare plan. That can mean outpatient counselling, a sober living residence, group therapy or 12 Step meetings near where you live, and staff will help you find a support group in your own area. For every 30 days you stay, some follow-up phone counselling is included at no extra charge, and more is available at $160 an hour. Graduates can also join a weekly alumni meeting on Zoom. If drinking was the main problem, you can also sign up for SoberLink breathalyzer monitoring for extra accountability at home.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does Valiant Behavioural Health Ottawa cost?
faqs.a: Recovery.com lists an estimated cash-pay rate starting at $11,500 for programs of 30 to 120 days. Valiant keeps its prices off its own website because the cost depends on program length, any detox you need and other factors, so call admissions for an exact quote or an information package. Medicard financing lets you spread payments over 6 months to 6 years.

faqs.q: How long does the treatment program run?
faqs.a: Our treatment programs run for 30, 60, 90 or 120 days, and the 90-day program offers sufficient time to address all aspects of substance abuse treatment, including mental health.

faqs.q: Does Valiant Behavioural Health Ottawa offer detox?
faqs.a: Detox is only arranged together with residential treatment, never on its own. Valiant coordinates medication-supported withdrawal management before the program starts, and you need to be clean for at least four days before rehab begins. Its FAQ also says clients who arrive without having detoxed are admitted to hospital at their own expense, so ask admissions how detox will work in your case.

faqs.q: Where is the centre and how do I get there?
faqs.a: The centre is at 4278 Boundary Road in Carlsbad Springs, in the east end of the City of Ottawa. From downtown Ottawa, take Highway 417 east to the Boundary Road exit, about a 25 to 30 minute drive. From Toronto, follow the 401 east and the 416 north to Ottawa, then the 417 east, roughly four and a half hours in total. Recovery.com lists airport transfers among the centre's off-site services.

You leave with an aftercare plan made with the follow-up counsellor, which can include outpatient counselling, sober living, group therapy and 12 Step meetings. Some follow-up phone counselling is included for every 30 days you stayed, extra sessions cost $160 an hour, and graduates can join a weekly alumni Zoom meeting. Valiant also runs a sober living residence in Ottawa for people who want more support first.

faqs.q: Is this a private centre? Will OHIP cover it?
faqs.a: It's private. Valiant is a pay-for-fee program that isn't government funded, so OHIP and other provincial health plans won't pay for it. Some private insurance and third-party plans do cover treatment: you pay the centre and then claim the cost from your insurer. Medicard financing is available if you'd rather pay monthly.

faqs.q: Does Valiant Behavioral Health accept insurance?
faqs.a: We are a private, pay-for-fee program, and some insurance plans cover treatment: you pay the centre and submit your receipt to your insurer. We offer a free consultation to help potential clients determine whether their plan covers our services.

faqs.q: How does the Valiant Behavioural Health treatment program differ from others?
faqs.a: Our treatment program is individualized and tailored to each client’s specific needs. We offer only nine beds, which allows us to provide a personalized approach to treatment that is often lacking in other facilities.

faqs.q: Does Valiant Behavioural Health offer aftercare programs?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer personalized aftercare programs to ensure that our clients can successfully transition back into society and maintain their recovery.
Yes, we are licensed by the Ministry of Health and Long-Term Care.

faqs.q: What is the admission process like for patients?
faqs.a: The majority of our referrals come from healthcare professionals or family members. Once someone is referred, they can call us directly and schedule an intake evaluation.

faqs.q: Are family members allowed to visit their loved ones during their stay at Valiant Behavioral Health?
faqs.a: Yes, family members are allowed to visit their loved ones by appointment and depending on their therapeutic schedule.
